touches.text: Prebuild face: the chart chain, eight machines, each answering one question before a build begins: orient (what is asked, where does it live), constrain (what bounds it), survey (what already exists), decompose (how does it split), triage (what first, by what standard), hypothesize (what do we expect, how would we know we're wrong), validate (what does DONE mean, measured), and after the build, verdict (what done actually meant).

Machine: tools plus the glue that holds them together. Has an owner. Anything that calls another component, uses other tools, or owns state it must gate is a machine. Lives inside its device (cairn/devices/<device>/machines/<machine>/), or in cairn/machines/ when several devices hold one (16).
A device's code lives in cairn/devices/<device>/; its data in ~/.cairn/devices/<device>/<instance>/.
A device owns its state: only the device writes under its own ~/.cairn/devices/<device>/<instance>/ tree.
A device holds machines and uses tools (1.3.1).
